out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Cleaning and Sanitizing
violations.observation: EHS observed that the food service worker was not aware of how to set up the 3 compartment sink for washing, rinsing and sanitizing the utensils.
violations.corrective_action: EHS trained and demonstrated how to set up the 3 compartment sink, how to create the chemical sanitizer solution and how to air dry the utensils, during the inspection for understanding and compliance.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: EHS observed that the food establishment did not have an Employee Health policy in place, accessible or acknowledged in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided a copy of the Employee Health policy which was reviewed and signed during the inspection for compliance.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided the CFM with a copy of the written procedures and reviewed them for understanding and compliance, during the inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located by the 3 compartment sink is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing, by a chair and large bucket.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM relocated the chair and bucket, during the inspection, for compliance.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided at the handwashing sink used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided a hand washing sign to the CFM to post at the hand sink for compliance.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: EHS observed that the interior of the ice bin has an accumulation of dirt, possible mold and buildup throughout the inside.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will need to empty the ice bin, wash, rinse and sanitize the interior and provide proof of cleaning to the EHS for a follow up.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: multiple containers of sugar on the counter top and in the storage.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM labeled the containers of sugar with the common names for compliance.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Ice As Coolant Not Used as Food
violations.observation: EHS observed that water bottles were being stored in the same ice in the ice machine that is used for providing ice for prepared drinks.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM removed the bottles of water from the ice bin and discontinued use of the ice machine for proper cleaning and sanitizing of the interior surfaces.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM placed the wet wiping cloths in sanitizer solution during the inspection for compliance.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the hand sink is not in operation and has no water supply.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will need to obtain repairs for the hand sink, reconnect the water supply and provide proof of repairs to the EHS for a follow up. CAFE GIO (Inspection Date: 01/09/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no chlorine test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will need to obtain a chlorine sanitizer test kit, and provide proof of purchase to the EHS for a follow up within 10 days.
